Foundations.title: Set overall budget and priorities
Foundations.description: Agree on total spend, top priorities, and decision-making process with all stakeholders.

Foundations.title: Draft initial guest list
Foundations.description: Create a preliminary guest list to guide venue capacity and catering quotes.

Foundations.title: Choose and book ceremony & reception venue
Foundations.description: Popular venues book 12–18 months out. Visit at least 3, check capacity, catering exclusivity, and parking.

Foundations.title: Set the wedding date (confirmed with venue)
Foundations.description: Confirm the date once venue is secured.

Booking.title: Book photographer and/or videographer
Booking.description: Top photographers book fast. Review portfolios, ask about backup plans and RAW file delivery.

Booking.title: Book caterer or confirm in-house catering
Booking.description: Request a tasting session. Clarify dietary accommodations in the contract.

Booking.title: Book officiant / priest / celebrant
Booking.description: For religious ceremonies, book well in advance and confirm ceremony requirements.

Booking.title: Book music / band / DJ
Booking.description: Confirm playlist flexibility, equipment, and overtime rates.

Booking.title: Book florist / decorator
Booking.description: Share your theme and colour palette. Confirm flowers seasonal availability.

Booking.title: Book hair and makeup artist
Booking.description: Schedule a trial run at least 2 months before the event.

Booking.title: Order wedding attire
Booking.description: Allow 4–6 months for custom made; 2–3 months for alterations.

Booking.title: Book transport (couple and guests)
Booking.description: Arrange transport for the wedding party and consider shuttle services for guests.

Details.title: Send save-the-dates
Details.description: Send to all guests, especially those who need to travel.

Details.title: Send formal invitations
Details.description: Include RSVP deadline (6–8 weeks before event), menu choices, and directions.

Details.title: Confirm dietary requirements from RSVPs
Details.description: Compile final dietary list and share with caterer.

Details.title: Book cake / dessert table
Details.description: Book a tasting. Confirm delivery logistics with the venue.

Details.title: Create seating plan
Details.description: Finalise once RSVPs are in. Use accessibility needs to allocate appropriate seats.

Details.title: Finalise ceremony order and vows
Details.description: Share the run-sheet with the officiant, venue, and MC.

Details.title: Arrange event insurance
Details.description: Wedding insurance covers cancellation, venue damage, and vendor no-shows.

Final Week.title: Confirm all vendors (phone/email check-in)
Final Week.description: Confirm arrival times, contacts, and any last-minute requirements with every vendor.

Final Week.title: Deliver final guest count and dietary list to caterer
Final Week.description: Most caterers require final numbers 5–7 days before.

Final Week.title: Prepare vendor payments and gratuities
Final Week.description: Prepare envelopes or transfers. Assign someone to hand them out on the day.

Final Week.title: Delegate day-of tasks to wedding party / coordinator
Final Week.description: Distribute the run-sheet. Ensure at least one person can handle emergencies.

Event Day.title: Morning preparation and getting ready
Event Day.description: Hair, makeup, and attire. Allow extra time — things always run behind schedule.

Event Day.title: Ceremony
Event Day.description: The ceremony is the heart of the day. Arrive 30 minutes early.

Event Day.title: Photography session (portraits)
Event Day.description: Typically 30–60 minutes of formal portraits after the ceremony.

Event Day.title: Reception and meal service
Event Day.description: Welcome drinks, meal service, speeches, and cake cutting.

Event Day.title: Dancing and entertainment
Event Day.description: First dance, parent dances, open floor.

After.title: Send thank-you notes
After.description: Personalised notes within 2 weeks. Include gift acknowledgements.

After.title: Review and settle final vendor invoices
After.description: Cross-check against contracts. Dispute any discrepancies promptly.

Foundations.title: Set budget and theme
Foundations.description: Agree on budget and party theme. Consider the guest of honour's preferences.

Foundations.title: Create guest list and confirm numbers
Foundations.description: Finalise the guest list to guide venue and catering decisions.

Foundations.title: Book venue
Foundations.description: Restaurant private room, party venue, or home. Confirm capacity and catering policy.

Booking.title: Book caterer or plan menu
Booking.description: For home parties, plan the menu. For venues, confirm catering options and dietary needs.

Booking.title: Order birthday cake
Booking.description: Custom cakes need 2–3 weeks. Confirm flavours, design, and allergens.

Booking.title: Book entertainment
Booking.description: Clown, magician, DJ, or activity provider. Get references and check insurance.

Details.title: Send invitations
Details.description: Digital or physical invitations. Include RSVP deadline, directions, and theme details.

Details.title: Arrange decorations and party supplies
Details.description: Order or DIY decorations aligned with the theme.

Details.title: Confirm final guest count with venue/caterer
Details.description: Update numbers with any last-minute RSVPs.

Final Week.title: Confirm all bookings and logistics
Final Week.description: Call all vendors to confirm times, addresses, and requirements.

Final Week.title: Prepare decorations and set up plan
Final Week.description: Pack decorations and plan the set-up timeline for the day before or morning of.

Final Week.title: Charge and test any AV / playlist equipment
Final Week.description: Test speakers, projector, and microphone. Prepare the playlist.

Event Day.title: Set up venue (decorations, tables, activities)
Event Day.description: Arrive at least 90 minutes early to set up.

Event Day.title: Welcome guests and run party programme
Event Day.description: Greet guests, run activities, manage the timeline.

Event Day.title: Cake, singing and photos
Event Day.description: The centrepiece moment. Designate someone for photography.

After.title: Send thank-you messages
After.description: Short, personalised thank-you messages to all guests.

Foundations.title: Define event goals, target audience, and success metrics
Foundations.description: Clarify what the event aims to achieve and how success will be measured.

Foundations.title: Form organising committee and assign roles
Foundations.description: Assign lead roles: logistics, finance, volunteers, communications, and safety.

Foundations.title: Apply for permits (venue, road closure, noise, food)
Foundations.description: Permit processing can take 4–8 weeks. Apply as early as possible. Requirements vary by location.

Foundations.title: Arrange event liability insurance
Foundations.description: Required by most venues and local authorities. Cover includes public liability and cancellation.

Foundations.title: Book venue / outdoor space
Foundations.description: Confirm accessibility, parking, power supply, and waste management.

Booking.title: Book caterers or coordinate food stalls
Booking.description: Ensure variety and dietary coverage. Confirm food handler certifications.

Booking.title: Book AV / PA system and stage equipment
Booking.description: Size the PA to the venue. Include hearing loop if accessibility is required.

Booking.title: Book first aid provider
Booking.description: Mandatory for events over 200 guests in most jurisdictions. Confirm staff-to-guest ratio.

Booking.title: Book security team
Booking.description: SIA-licensed staff for public events. Brief on crowd management and emergency procedures.

Booking.title: Recruit and brief volunteers
Booking.description: Assign clear roles, provide training, and arrange refreshments.

Details.title: Launch event publicity and social media
Details.description: Social media, local press, community noticeboards. Include accessibility info.

Details.title: Set up ticketing (if applicable)
Details.description: Use an accessible ticketing platform. Offer concessionary pricing.

Details.title: Finalise programme and schedule
Details.description: Share with all vendors, volunteers, and key stakeholders.

Details.title: Conduct site walkthrough with key stakeholders
Details.description: Check accessibility routes, emergency exits, first aid stations, and vendor positions.

Details.title: Prepare emergency and evacuation plan
Details.description: Share with all staff, volunteers, security, and first aid teams.

Final Week.title: Confirm all vendors and volunteers
Final Week.description: Final check-in with everyone. Distribute schedules and emergency contacts.

Final Week.title: Set up event management communications (walkie-talkies / group chat)
Final Week.description: Ensure all team leads can communicate in real time on the day.

Final Week.title: Prepare volunteer briefing packs
Final Week.description: Include role descriptions, schedule, emergency procedures, and contact list.

Event Day.title: Venue set-up and equipment check
Event Day.description: Arrive 3–4 hours early. Test all AV, check accessibility routes, and brief all staff.

Event Day.title: Open gates / doors and welcome attendees
Event Day.description: Ensure accessible entry is clearly signed and staffed.

Event Day.title: Run event programme
Event Day.description: MC manages the programme. Team leads monitor their areas.

Event Day.title: Venue clear-down and waste management
Event Day.description: Leave the site in the agreed condition. Segregate waste for recycling.

After.title: Collect feedback from attendees and volunteers
After.description: Survey or debrief to capture learnings for future events.

After.title: Produce event report (financials, attendance, outcomes)
After.description: Document what worked, what didn't, and recommendations for next time.
